canonical_title: Ecological State at a Temporal Cut: Interface-Dependent Interaction
state_concept: state is the least information that must survive an observational temporal cut under a declared scientific contract

temporal_geometry.present: observation cut O_t and its kernel partition B_t, not a finite-width temporal axis
temporal_geometry.past: raw MLTR replacement history is primitive and immutable; retained history information is derived from carried semantics
temporal_geometry.latent_present: MRM primitive candidate law is behind the visible cut; latent response type is derived from response tables under a declared grammar
temporal_geometry.future: CCOC future is an exogenously declared query grammar, not a future state variable

headline: decoder prerequisite structure determines the interaction order of ecological state addressability debt
headline_quantity: v_R(S) is computed from explicit grammar traces and quotient size, not assigned directly
headline_theorem: an m-bit exterior decoder with minimal prerequisite set R contributes its unique nonzero Mobius dividend of m bits on coalition R union {F}
headline_special_case: R={H,Theta} gives pure H x Theta x F interaction m; R=empty gives an F main effect; singleton R gives pairwise interaction

realizability_boundaries.fixed_partition_bound: fixed precomputed partitions on a one-class baseline cannot generate positive interaction by common refinement alone
realizability_boundaries.immutable_history_no_activation: a zero-debt post-cut audit preserving raw MLTR history fixes the history partition
realizability_boundaries.fixed_grammar_mrm_zero_debt: candidate-safe zero debt under one fixed grammar implies a singleton MRM response type

explicit_grammar.carrier: P_H x P_Theta x {0,1}^m with MLTR carried-map primitives and MRM response-table primitives
explicit_grammar.grammar_rule: F supplies decoder primitives; decode_i is well typed iff F is present and every interface in decoder prerequisite set R is present
explicit_grammar.state_equivalence: two worlds are equivalent iff all generated legal traces agree
explicit_grammar.quotient_formula: |Q_S| = 2^(1[H in S] + 1[Theta in S] + m*1[F in S and R subset S])
explicit_grammar.formula_status: derived theorem about explicit trace quotients, not implementation definition

decoder_requirement_classification.R_empty: m-bit exterior burden is an F main effect; three-way dividend zero
decoder_requirement_classification.R_H: m-bit exterior burden is pure H x F pairwise interaction; three-way dividend zero
decoder_requirement_classification.R_Theta: m-bit exterior burden is pure Theta x F pairwise interaction; three-way dividend zero
decoder_requirement_classification.R_H_Theta: m-bit exterior burden is pure H x Theta x F interaction
decoder_requirement_classification.interpretation: pure higher-order interaction is conditional on interface completeness and is falsified by grammar rules that bypass required interfaces

numeric_illustration.claim_boundary: illustration of the R={H,Theta} structural case, not a universal ecological constant

literature_positioning.bisimulation_and_state_abstraction: Givan, Dean, and Greig 2003; Li, Walsh, and Littman 2006

novelty_boundary: CREST does not claim novelty for quotient state abstraction, Mobius accounting, ecological memory, or the existence of grammars with higher-order terms. It claims a temporal-cut state construction with strict companion realizability boundaries and an explicit grammar/trace characterization linking minimal decoder interface prerequisites to the interaction order of state addressability debt.
ecological_consequence: modular state design is reliable only when future queries factor through component interfaces without requiring their joint availability; jointly addressable queries create higher-order representational obligations
supporting_results: abstract fixed-closure marked-cycle Delta=log2(n)-1 remains an exact supporting extremum but not a literal immutable-history theorem
abstract fixed-closure b-log2(3) three-audit family remains a supporting extremum rather than the companion-derived headline
future-conditioned MLTR and grammar-conditioned MRM 2^k prefix frontiers are retained as illustrative binary-signature examples, not evidence of structural identity
six-world obstruction-change diagnostics remain compatibility regressions

implementation.previous_direct_value_status: retained for provenance/regression but no longer mathematical support for the flagship claim
